name: claude-relais
description: Claude Code plugins to cut token usage and check what Claude says.

plugins.name: relais
plugins.description: Context gauge + /relais handoff + automatic resume after /clear: stop re-reading huge conversations on every action. 100% local.

plugins.name: avocat
plugins.description: Devil's advocate mode: while switched on, an independent read-only agent tries to refute every Claude answer (facts, code, actions) before it is final. /avocat on|off or the relais dashboard. No extra service: the checking agent only uses Claude Code (read-only tools and web search).

plugins.name: images
plugins.description: Image generation inside Claude Code: Claude writes the prompt, generates, looks at the result and retries. One engine chosen at setup: free local Stable Diffusion WebUI, or Codex CLI with a paid ChatGPT plan. 100% local except the Codex engine.
